scenes.heading: Avoiding burnout as a creator whose life is the content

sents.d: Avoiding burnout as a creator whose life is the content
Sustainable output requires boundaries most creators don't set early enough.

When your personal life is also your content source, the line between working and living can disappear entirely, which is a major and specific burnout risk in this field compared to many other businesses.

Deciding in advance what parts of your life are genuinely off-limits for content, rather than deciding in the moment, protects both your wellbeing and your relationships from being treated as constant content opportunities.

Building in planned breaks from posting, and communicating them to your audience rather than disappearing without explanation, tends to be received better and protects against the anxiety of feeling like you can never stop.

take: Set content boundaries and plan breaks in advance.
